cat > /tmp/analyze_subnets.sh << 'EOF' #!/bin/bash # Extract all subnets echo "=== SUBNETS ===" jq -r '.deployment.resources[] | select(.type == "aws:ec2/subnet:Subnet") | {subnet_id: .outputs.id, name: .tags.Name, region: .outputs.availabilityZone, vpc: .outputs.vpcId}' /tmp/pulumi-state.json > /tmp/all_subnets.json # Extract all instances with their subnets (these create ENIs) echo "=== INSTANCES (create ENIs) ===" jq -r '.deployment.resources[] | select(.type == "aws:ec2/instance:Instance") | {instance_id: .outputs.id, subnet_id: .outputs.subnetId}' /tmp/pulumi-state.json > /tmp/instance_subnets.json # Extract all explicit ENIs echo "=== EXPLICIT ENIs ===" jq -r '.deployment.resources[] | select(.type == "aws:ec2/networkInterface:NetworkInterface") | {eni_id: .outputs.id, subnet_id: .outputs.subnetId}' /tmp/pulumi-state.json > /tmp/eni_subnets.json # Collect all subnets with any ENI/instance cat /tmp/all_subnets.json | jq -r '.subnet_id' | sort -u > /tmp/all_subnet_ids.txt cat /tmp/instance_subnets.json | jq -r '.subnet_id' | sort -u > /tmp/used_subnet_ids.txt cat /tmp/eni_subnets.json | jq -r '.subnet_id' | sort -u >> /tmp/used_subnet_ids.txt sort -u /tmp/used_subnet_ids.txt > /tmp/used_subnet_ids_unique.txt echo "All managed subnets:" cat /tmp/all_subnets.json | jq -r '"\(.subnet_id) (\(.name)) in \(.region)"' echo "" echo "Subnets WITH instances/ENIs:" cat /tmp/used_subnet_ids_unique.txt echo "" echo "Subnets WITH NO network interfaces:" comm -23 <(sort /tmp/all_subnet_ids.txt) <(cat /tmp/used_subnet_ids_unique.txt) EOF bash /tmp/analyze_subnets.sh

cd /workspace/pulumi && cat > /tmp/final_analysis.sh << 'EOF' #!/bin/bash # Extract all subnets with proper name extraction jq -r '.deployment.resources[] | select(.type == "aws:ec2/subnet:Subnet") | {subnet_id: .outputs.id, name: (.outputs.tagsAll.Name // "N/A"), region: .outputs.availabilityZone, vpc: .outputs.vpcId}' /tmp/pulumi-state.json | jq -s '.' > /tmp/all_subnets.json # Get all subnets with instances or explicit ENIs jq -r '.deployment.resources[] | select(.type == "aws:ec2/instance:Instance") | .outputs.subnetId' /tmp/pulumi-state.json | sort -u > /tmp/used_subnets.txt jq -r '.deployment.resources[] | select(.type == "aws:ec2/networkInterface:NetworkInterface") | .outputs.subnetId' /tmp/pulumi-state.json | sort -u >> /tmp/used_subnets.txt # Get unique used subnets sort -u /tmp/used_subnets.txt > /tmp/used_subnets_unique.txt # Get all subnet IDs jq -r '.[] | .subnet_id' /tmp/all_subnets.json | sort > /tmp/all_subnet_ids_sorted.txt # Find unused subnets echo "=== SUBNET ANALYSIS ===" echo "" echo "All Managed Subnets (from Pulumi state):" jq -r '.[] | "\(.subnet_id) (\(.name)) - Region: \(.region), VPC: \(.vpc)"' /tmp/all_subnets.json echo "" echo "Subnets WITH Network Interfaces (Instances or explicit ENIs):" cat /tmp/used_subnets_unique.txt echo "" echo "Subnets WITH NO Network Interfaces:" comm -23 <(cat /tmp/all_subnet_ids_sorted.txt) <(sort /tmp/used_subnets_unique.txt) EOF bash /tmp/final_analysis.sh
